name: extension-host core + desktop + workspace, updates that do not state first-party-selection-v1 refused
comment: Held by scripts/verify-selection-updates.py (`task selection:updates`) against a signed purpose-built host that
is the signed application in everything selection reads, headless: the shipped provider catalogue around the
real providers of this tree (and, for the desktop-only profile, around the RELEASED desktop provider as the
designated baseline), with newer releases of the same sources installed per user. The design SDL is the
unchanged contract: an update adds no schema. The pins are what tell the binaries apart, because an identical
digest cannot prove which binary ran. A row that is missing or extra fails the profile.
An explicit rejected profile: each per-user update is INCOMPATIBLE / selection-feature-required before it loads, and each baseline keeps the slot with the refusal in its reason.
